THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / OCTOBER 2026
STREET & CITY
178
STUDY 078
Floral Sheer Blouse & Flare Jeans
Rights check
Source: 24982.jpg
Earthy, flowing, relaxed
WORKING NOTES
- The sheer floral blouse and flared jeans are the defining
silhouette.
- Keep the wet path and hedge for an outdoor autumn
setting.
Try this: Keep the wet path and hedge for an autumn
setting.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
straight black hair walks along a wet
stone path beside a low hedge. She
wears a sheer amber floral blouse with
flared sleeves, a tie front, and a white
cami underneath. A silver conchos belt
cinches her waist. Light-wash flared
jeans complete the look. Her expression
is calm, with her gaze to the side. Soft
autumn daylight, a palette of amber,
rust, and pale denim. Earthy and
relaxed, in the style of an autumn
street-style editorial.
